analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited discussed its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance during its earnings conference call held on July 31, 2026. Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance upward to between INR325 crore and INR350 crore, supported by strong performance in core business loans and the rollout of its AkikoPay platform. The company expanded its offline presence to 25 branches across 19 cities and expects PAT margins of 9% to 11% for the year. Additionally, management confirmed there are no fundraising plans for the next six to twelve months. Akiko Global Services Limited published its Q1 FY27 investor presentation, reporting revenue from operations of ₹6,812.2 Lacs and Profit After Tax of ₹701.6 Lacs.

guidance.claim: Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance to between INR325 crore and INR350 crore.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management targets PAT margins of 9% to 11% for the current year, with potential to reach 12% to 14% next year if AkikoPay performs well.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year. If AkikoPay works very well, next year that will go up to 12% to 14%.

guidance.claim: Management expects to sustain a 70% to 100% year-on-year growth CAGR over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated its target to achieve revenue between ₹300 crore and ₹325 crore for FY27 with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: The company expects minimum revenue growth of 70% to 100% in FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: Akiko Global Services targets reaching INR 1,000 crores in revenue and PAT margins of 12% to 13% by 2030.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management targets full-year FY27 revenue of over INR 300 crores.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects Q1 FY27 revenue to be between INR 65 crores and INR 70 crores.
guidance.quote: This quarter I'll close around INR65 crores to INR70 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently the company's fastest-growing loan product.
The company is observing strong customer engagement in payments and credit products on the AkikoPay platform.
demand_outlook.quote: In the use case of payments, we are seeing good interaction. And in the use case of credit products, I am seeing good interaction.

demand_outlook.claim: The company disburses more than 16,000 credit cards per month.
demand_outlook.quote: If we talk about the credit card segment, which used to be our core business at one time, today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has achieved a monthly loan disbursement run rate exceeding INR 400 crores, taking its annualized book to INR 5,000 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's loan book comprises INR 320 crores in unsecured loans and INR 80 crores in secured loans.
demand_outlook.quote: INR320 crores unsecured, INR80 crores secured.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently added new branches in Kolkata, UP, and Hyderabad.
capex_expansion.quote: This year we recently added a Kolkata branch, two branches in UP, one more branch in Hyderabad, and currently these are the ones.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to open additional branches in Indore and Kerala over the next two to three months.
capex_expansion.quote: Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched an upgraded Android version of the AkikoPay platform during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: The quarter also marked a significant milestone in the Company's digital strategy with the successful launch of the upgraded Android version of AkikoPay, delivering a substantially enhanced user experience.

capex_expansion.claim: Development of the iOS version of AkikoPay is currently progressing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent approximately INR 1 crore in total on building technology infrastructure for AkikoPay.
capex_expansion.quote: Not much, around INR1 crores in total so far on building technology etc, that is it.

margins_costs.claim: Branches opened in previous quarters have begun contributing to profitability in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: As I mentioned last time, our profit faced slight stress last quarter because we opened several branches across multiple cities. This time, those branches have contributed to profitability, enabling us to deliver good growth this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Management plans to acquire AkikoPay customers at negligible cost using existing staff and database.
margins_costs.quote: We will not incur any unnecessary expenses on AkikoPay. We will acquire customers at a negligible cost using only our employees and existing database.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay achieves customer acquisition costs that are approximately 40% lower than traditional channels due to its digital-first model.
margins_costs.quote: ~40% lower CAC vs traditional channels, enabled by a lean, digital-first model

margins_costs.claim: The company delivered an EBITDA of ₹1,009.8 Lacs in Q1 FY27, representing a 144.6% year-on-year growth.
Akiko Global Services achieved a PAT margin of 10.3% for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: I had given a vision that 9% to 11% PAT could be maintained, that we did of 10.3%.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 margins faced temporary pressure due to planned investments in branch expansion and technology infrastructure for AkikoPay.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that.

margins_costs.claim: The company's customer acquisition cost is between INR 10 to INR 15 when marketing to consented customers.
margins_costs.quote: Where Paytm, PhonePe or CRED spends around INR250 to acquire a customer, there our cost comes to INR10 to INR15.

orders_capacity.claim: Management aims to scale monthly loan disbursements to around INR1,000 crores by December.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

orders_capacity.claim: The company receives an average payout of 3.10% on its unsecured loan disbursements.
orders_capacity.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals reached over ₹450 crore while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total combined workforce crossed 900 people, including direct employees and channel partners.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

orders_capacity.claim: Physical branch presence increases digital lead conversion rates from 10% to between 60% and 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has no plans to raise capital for the next 6 months to 1 year.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

capital_allocation.claim: Receivable days decreased from 133 days to 110 days and are expected to drop below 90 days in Q2.
capital_allocation.quote: From 133 days, receivable days are coming down to 110 days. In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash used in operating activities stood at ₹567.3 Lacs in FY26.
The company completed its core integrations without taking on external investment or fund-raising.
capital_allocation.quote: you see, today we have completed almost all our integrations without any investment, without any fund-raising.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that it is not building a cash-burn fintech model.
capital_allocation.quote: And one thing I would like to clearly say here, we are not building any cash-burn fintech model.

risks_headwinds.claim: Quarterly revenue from the Dubai business was impacted by war and stood at INR1.25 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: App Store compliance requirements caused minor delays in launching the AkikoPay iOS application.
risks_headwinds.quote: There were some compliance-related issues on the App Store -- since it's a financial app, compliance involves certain requirements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking business performance remains subject to macroeconomic risks, competition, and technological execution risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company’s future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cash flows, the Company’s market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dubai operations experienced temporary margin and revenue pressure due to geopolitical issues around the Iran region.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

risks_headwinds.claim: Integration of AkikoPay on the Apple App Store experienced delays due to compliance requirements.
risks_headwinds.quote: AkikoPay has not been integrated in Apple yet because there were some compliance issues.
